reader.requirement: At --std 85, every execution of a READ of a relative file (format 1 sequential or NEXT, format 2 random; successful or not) updates the I-O status (FILE STATUS item) to the value §1985:VIII.1.3.4 assigns: 00, 10 at end, 14 relative number too large for the key, 23 invalid key, 46 no valid next record, 47 not open in input or I-O mode.
reader.edition-search: grep -n 'Edition|CobolVersion|Dialect' in KeyedIoEmitter.cs, SequentialIoEmitter.cs EmitRead/EmitStoreFileStatus, RelativeConnector.cs and FileConnector.cs's read guards (lines 752-858): no edition term on the READ status path; EmitStoreFileStatus is emitted unconditionally after every keyed READ.
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the witness pins 05/10/46/23 for an absent OPTIONAL relative file; 47 (not open, open OUTPUT), 14 (key too small), 00 after a failing READ, and the overwrite of a sentinel value in every status are covered only by probe p4stat

probes.printed: READ-IN-OUTPUT-MODE=47 READ-NOT-OPEN=47 SEQ1=00 2 R002 SEQ2-RRN12-KEY-TOO-SMALL=14 SEQ3-AFTER-14=46 SEQ-AFTER-REOPEN=46
probes.expected: each READ overwrites the sentinel 'XX': 47 for open OUTPUT and for not open; sequential READ 00 then 14 for RRN 12 against a PIC 9 relative key (status 14), then 46

probes.printed: DYN-RANDOM=00 R012 DYN-NEXT-ATEND=10 DYN-NEXT-AFTER-ATEND=46 DYN-RANDOM2=00 R002 DYN-RANDOM-MISSING=23 NIK 00 DYN-RANDOM-AGAIN=00
probes.expected: dynamic access: random 00, NEXT at end 10, then 46, random again 00 (the status is updated back after a failure), missing 23, then 00 with the NOT INVALID KEY phrase seeing 00

citations.check: OK  §1985:VIII.4.5.4 GR3  (4.5.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR3

reader.notes: KeyedIoEmitter.EmitRead stores the connector's status into the FILE STATUS item after every READ, before the USE hook and the phrase branches, and the relative connector sets a status on every path. All six status values the relative READ can produce were observed overwriting a sentinel.

refuter.evidence: The reader's requirement lists 00/10/14/23/46/47 and omits 04, which §1985:VIII.1.3.4 (1) b and GR16 give a READ; attacked there. Probe r3len.cob (r3len-001): RECORD IS VARYING 1 TO 20 with a 5-character record read back: 00 (within the RECORD clause's bounds, the reading FileConnector.RecordLengthConflicts documents). Probe r3stat2.cob (r3stat2-001, with a zero-byte data file): connector A (30-byte FD) opens INPUT 00 on the empty file, connector B (20-byte FD) opens I-O 00 and writes RRN 1, A's random READ gives 04 (GR16 record length conflict, successful); START EQUAL miss 23 then READ NEXT 46 (status 46 item 1, failed START); OPTIONAL absent file opened I-O 05 (created), READ NEXT 10, random READ 23. Each READ overwrote an 'XX' sentinel. cite.py: OK  §1985:VIII.4.5.4 GR3 (the text is in GR3); OK  §1985:VIII.4.5.4 GR16 (the text is in GR16).
